image_prompt: A cyberpunk anime rendition of Prince Christian August of Zerbst-Dornburg, a 37-year-old Prussian general. He has sharp, angular features with a lean, austere face reflecting his stern moral character. His eyes are notably dreamy and idealistic, with a distant, contemplative gaze that betrays intellectual depth. Medium-length hair styled in an austere, formal manner typical of Prussian officers, rendered in dark tones with cyberpunk neon accents. He wears a high-collared military uniform coat with intricate geometric patterns and subtle holographic piping reflecting his rank and rigid formality. His physique is lean and disciplined from years of military service. His expression is serious and composed, with a subtle melancholy undertone. Incorporate cyberpunk aesthetic elements like faint neural interface lines along his temples, subtle luminescent insignia on his uniform, and a dignified yet detached demeanor. The overall appearance conveys austere intellectualism, moral seriousness, and resigned idealism tempered by the weight of unfulfilled ambitions.
book_context: Catherine the Great: A Life (or similar biographical work on Catherine II)
